data.narrative:
Majestic Labs is a Series A frontier-chip company founded by Ofer Shacham, Sha Rabii, and Masumi Reynders, having raised $100M+ to date. The valuation universe includes 11 peers across the Chips & Semiconductors sector: 3 public comps (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private players including SambaNova Systems, Cerebras, PsiQuantum, Etched, and Tenstorrent.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given data constraints. The Stage-Progression approach uses total capital raised ($100M) as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $200M. The Peer-Median method was not applicable; while 11 same-sector peers exist, the narrow filters for matching stage and valuation tier failed to yield three or more comparable datapoints, making a narrow-set median unreliable.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single method, supports a range of $170M (low) to $230M (high), with a median of $200M. Key uncertainties include the absence of sufficient stage-matched peer comparables in this sector—a structural limitation for private chip-stage companies—and reliance on the capital-raised proxy as the sole quantitative anchor. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending additional financial or operational metrics specific to Majestic Labs' technology differentiation and path to revenue.
